name: Stealth vision cones
oneLiner: Guards see through view cones clipped by walls (a ray-cast visibility polygon, the same rays that decide who is seen), each with a suspicion meter that fills faster when the player is close and in the middle of the cone and drains after the player slips out of sight; a '?' badge whose glyph fills with the meter, then a red '!' on alert, an alerted guard calls the guards within earshot, loses the player and searches. Tall grass hides the player completely, shade halves how far a guard can see them. Patrol routes with waits and look-around turns; guards face where their cone points (dir4 / side / facing for the sprite). Cones are drawn on the floor, soft and readable over any ground, crisp as whole pixels in a pixel game. The game keeps its rules: alerts come back as hooks (onAlert, onState, isAlert) for its own chase, call-for-help or fail rules.
fits: top-down action RPGs (enemies that notice you instead of a fixed aggro radius)
turn-based or real-time tactics with hidden movement (guards, sentries, cameras)
heist and sneak sections inside any top-down game
any 2D top-down canvas game, pixel or HD
notFor: side-scrolling platformers (cones are top-down floor shapes; a side view needs a different sight model)
line of sight for the player's own fog (use B-03 fog-of-war)
sound propagation through rooms (noise() is a plain radius)

needs: a fixed update step that calls update(dt) once per step after enemies move (also run by ?t= fast-forward and ?auto=1), update(0) while paused or behind a window
the player's point in world px (player(): {x, y} or null) and the tiles or boxes that block sight (walls)
per guard an id and a source (world px, or null when dead) or a patrol route; remove(id) on death; clear() on new game
hiding spots: hidden(x, y) -> 0..1 cover, true for tall grass, 'shadow' for shade (optional)
the draw pass: drawCones after the ground and before the sprites, drawMarks after the sprites and before the HUD, with the camera
the game's own reaction to an alert (chase, call help, fail): onAlert / isAlert(id) hooked into its enemy AI
provides: view cones clipped by walls (visibility polygons) drawn on the floor, coloured by state (calm, suspicious, alert, search)
per guard suspicion meter, '?' and '!' badges, states and events (onState, onAlert, onLost, onCall)
patrols with waits and look-around turns, investigate / chase / search walks for module-driven guards
facing(id) / dir4(id) / side(id) so the game draws each guard facing its cone
raise, noise, alertAll, calm; sees(x, y) and seenBy() for AI and autopilots; list(), stats(), hash() for tests and judges

params.label: Call for help radius (px at scale 1)

assets: module/vision-cones.js: the element as one dependency-free script (global GameDNA_VisionCones): wall ray caster (tile DDA, boxes, point test), visibility polygons with wall-corner rays, per-guard sight test, suspicion meter and state machine, patrols with look-around, call for help, noise, cones drawn smooth (radial gradient, rim) or rasterised as whole pixels (bands, dithered rim, crisp edge), '?' / '!' badges whose glyph fills with the meter
no image, font or audio files
